title: The cedar mill, iii
logline: Thursday. The mill floor. Alders through the floorboards. Chloe says 'brand narrative' out loud, in a mill, and hears it. Wood draws her hearing it.

panels.composition: The mill floor, vast, the roof half gone, alders growing up through the boards, light in shafts. CHLOE small in it. WOOD and BARNABY behind.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a vast ruined mill interior with the roof half gone and alder saplings growing up through the floorboards in shafts of light, a woman in a camel coat small in the space, a man and a dog behind

panels.composition: Chloe, talking, the way she talks now.

balloons.text: Julian's firm did a whole thing on this. Post-industrial. Authenticity as brand narr—

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a woman in a camel coat talking animatedly in a ruined mill, mid-word

panels.composition: Her face. Stopping. Hearing it. The alders behind her.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, close-up of a woman's face stopping mid-sentence as she hears what she has just said, alder saplings behind her

panels.composition: Wood, drawing her stopped. The dog on a fallen beam. Chloe looking at the pad, then at the mill.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a thin man drawing a woman who has stopped speaking in a ruined mill, a dog on a fallen beam

art.palette: limited; Sundays in watercolor, good now
art.paper: bristol; the browser; from 2008 coastal newsprint a week behind

notes: 'Brand narrative,' heard. 'It's long.' (The Sunday's line, earned here.)
